annotations.title: Read check results for a proposal

description: Read the check runs and commit statuses GitHub reports for a proposal's pull request head commit (cached for 60 s). state is retrieved, required_pending, required_failed or required_passed; validated is true only when the required checks passed on the exact commit the room created. task_evidence can be passed as the evidence of a room task result. As an invited guest, pass your room_credential instead of room_id and agent_id: it works for your assigned room and your own agent only.

proposal.description: The proposal id, or its room number (3 for P3).

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.
